value.rationale: A naturally occurring two-defective pool-testing family has a sharp static OR-cover characterization for all dimensions and a complete, verified 2–12 static/adaptive profile. The five-query OR basis requires exactly twelve coordinates; adaptive versus static shattering separates at 5,7,10,11 but not intervening instances, while triangular-number root constraints explain sharp failure of entropy bounds at 9 and 12. The result distinguishes balanced full decision trees from ordinary identification and provides reusable finite obstructions.
